text:
maya: Dropping a quick thread about the alerting preview in the SLO editor. New screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/alert-preview-compact.png. Two quick debates: 1) suppression badges 94 show full reason inline or condensed with tooltip? 2) channel display 94 show full stacked list or inline condensed row with expand?

liam: Condensed by default with a visible affordance to expand. Most users scan quickly and don't need full text. Tooltip for details. :mag:

nora: Accessibility push: condensed inline must still surface full text to screen readers. If we use `aria-hidden` for visual truncation, expose a separate offscreen element with full text. Also ensure badges get keyboard focus.

kevin: UX microcopy: options: 1) "Suppressed B7 schedule" 2) "Muted until 3:00PM" 3) "Silenced by rota". My vote: #1 is compact and clear. Avoid passive voice.

maya: Agree on #1 as default. For channels: show up to 2 inline chips and a "+N" button to expand the stack. Keeps preview compact but preserves ordering when expanded.

liam: Small visual note: make the "+N" control keyboard-focusable and announce "expand channels" for SR users.

nora: Also contrast: suppression badge currently uses low-contrast yellow on white. Suggest swapping to a darker token or adding 1px border for AA compliance. I'll add exact tokens in the doc.

kevin: On fallback routing: show a muted label `fallback: regional` on the bottom line when applicable. If there's a canary, show `canary -> us-west` as a prefix icon with tooltip.

maya: Action list: @nora will add a11y checklist and tokens, @kevin will propose three microcopy variants for the badge, @liam will prototype the +N expand flow and keyboard interactions. I'll update figma and link here. design-bot: figma updated https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/alert-preview-compact

liam: I'll also add a brief recording of keyboard nav to the doc.

maya: Thanks all  Sync Monday 9:30am to sign off.
